lessons.content: Welcome to Full-Stack Web Development! In this lesson we unpack the client-server lifecycle, HTTP request headers, REST conventions, and development environment setup.
Deep dive into functional React hooks: useState, useEffect, useCallback, custom hooks, and immutable state management patterns for interactive web apps.
Learn how to construct clean Express routers, implement CORS, parse request bodies, validate incoming DTO payloads, and handle errors centralized.

lessons.lesson_title: Connecting MySQL 8.0 with mysql2 & Connection Pooling
lessons.content: Step-by-step implementation of mysql2 connection pools in Node.js, parameterized queries to prevent SQL injections, and transaction management.

lessons.lesson_title: User Authentication with bcrypt & JWT/Session Security
lessons.content: Protecting API routes with password hashing, salt rounds, session cookies, Bearer tokens, and role-based access control (RBAC).

lessons.lesson_title: Foundations of Machine Learning & Python Ecosystem
lessons.content: Setting up NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, and understanding supervised vs unsupervised learning workflows with real-world datasets.
Tensors, computation graphs, forward pass, backpropagation, gradient descent optimizers, and loss functions explained visually.
Building CNNs for feature extraction, pooling, edge detection, image classification, and transfer learning with pre-trained models.

lessons.lesson_title: Principles of Visual Hierarchy & Typographic Scale
lessons.content: Mastering the 60-30-10 color rule, modular type scales, vertical rhythm, and contrast ratios compliant with WCAG AA standards.
Defining atomic design tokens: colors, spacing scales, elevation, radius, component variants, and interactive micro-states.

lessons.lesson_title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals & AWS Core Services
lessons.content: Understanding EC2 compute, S3 object storage, VPC networking, IAM security policies, and regional availability zones.
Writing optimized Dockerfiles, docker-compose orchestration, environment isolation, and production image caching techniques.
